description: This bar chart illustrates the average entropy across sycophancy reduction methods on static experiments for three different AI models. The horizontal axis, labeled “Different AI Models,” displays categories for GPT-4, Claude, and Llama, listed in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Entropy of Average Values,” represents a linear scale ranging from 3.0 to 6.0, with tick marks at 0.5 intervals. Three bars are present for each AI model, representing the “Baseline” method in a light brown color, the “Source Info” method in a light orange color, and the “Direct Command” method in a light teal color. For GPT-4, the “Baseline” bar extends to approximately 5.2, the “Source Info” bar to approximately 5.0, and the “Direct Command” bar to approximately 4.7. For Claude, the “Baseline” bar extends to approximately 5.1, the “Source Info” bar to approximately 4.8, and the “Direct Command” bar to approximately 4.6. For Llama, the “Baseline” bar extends to approximately 4.9, the “Source Info” bar to approximately 4.6, and the “Direct Command” bar to approximately 4.4. The bars are grouped by AI model, with each method represented as a separate bar within that group, and no bars are visually emphasized.
